Traveling with your full set of Apple gear usually means lugging around a tangle of cables and wall adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank aims to solve that problem by packing everything you need into one compact battery. It has a built-in wall plug, an integrated USB-C cable, and a dedicated magnetic charger for your Apple Watch. It's exactly the kind of accessory I love bringing on trips, handling everything from on-the-go charging to overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest happenings in the world of MagSafe and wireless charging, helping you get the most out of the wireless charging-capable Apple devices in your hands.

Designed for Travel

The back of the RORRY Flow power bank has foldable wall prongs built right in, so there's no need to carry a separate wall adapter to recharge the power bank itself. Just plug it straight into the socket at your hotel or holiday rental. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I genuinely love this design!), meaning you don't even need to bring a charging cable to power up your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more.

Although I usually focus on iPhone MagSafe here, this power bank comes specially equipped with a dedicated 5W magnetic charger for Apple Watch. Just pop your Apple Watch on and it tops up effortlessly — no need to carry the original charger, and the magnetic hold is impressively secure.

The power bank packs a 10,000mAh capacity, more than enough to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch going throughout a long trip. For me, the most practical feature is its 40W USB-C output, which can even rescue your MacBook Air in a pinch (when the lid is closed).

Wrapping up the RORRY Flow power bank

If you're looking to streamline the Apple accessories in your travel bag, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall plug, Apple Watch charger, and USB-C cable into one unit, and it's slim enough to slip easily into a wallet or pocket.

You can pick up the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from the RORRY website or Amazon.
